name: siddhesh-amrale-portfolio
description: Siddhesh Amrale - AI, data, cloud, performance and robotics AI engineering portfolio

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir build-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.labs:test: python -m pytest -q forge/tests link/tests smr/tests pilot/tests
scripts.labs:cases: python -m forge build-cases --out public/forge && python -m link build-cases --out public/link && python -m smr build-cases --out public/smr
